review.decision: Test the explicit attempt refusal contract in the existing producer fixtures
review.notes: Older fixtures used a state enum alone. The driver now must positively attest that input was never submitted to permit safe retirement or retry.

cases.description: A positively unsent claimed generation yields to an unclaimed new keyed update
cases.setup: Reuse the early deadline and producer update fixtures with the transport's explicit not-submitted report and known transient reason.
cases.action: Update a keyed value during a refused attempt over the shared input lock.
cases.expected: The newer unclaimed generation retains its original deadline and remains eligible; a stale generation never overwrites or replays into it.
